pre_caption: The video starts with a medium shot from a high angle, looking down at the torso and upper legs of a person lying upside down in the center foreground on a slide. The camera then tilts upward, transitioning into a low-angle wide shot. As this happens, the person's torso moves out of the bottom of the frame, leaving their legs and feet at the bottom center. This movement reveals the surrounding environment: other people in green tracksuits are seated in the middle ground on the left and right of the slide, while standing guards in magenta jumpsuits occupy the middle ground on the left and the background on the right and center. The slide itself extends vertically through the center of the frame, from the foreground to its opening in the background, set against a painted wall that fills the entire background of the scene.
